main.description: Where the reader stands with a Work. One per Work: the record key is the Work's Catalog identifier. Exists with or without a Copy. No record means unread.

work.description: Catalog identifier of the Work; equals the record key. 'isbn:<isbn13>' when the Catalog does not know the Work.

isbn.description: ISBN-13 of the Edition the reader read or is reading.

finishedAt.description: When the reader finished the Work, if they said.
